description: The line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct configurations—en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn—used in a multilingual expansion of large language models. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 23, representing the layer index in the model architecture, while the y-axis, labeled "Similarity," ranges from 0.00 to 0.45, indicating the degree of similarity between representations. The en&en configuration (brown line) starts at a similarity of approximately 0.07, rises sharply to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then gradually declines to about 0.08 at layer 21 before sharply increasing to 0.44 at layer 23. The en&es configuration (blue line) follows a similar trend, starting at 0.06, peaking at 0.25 at layer 6, and decreasing to 0.05 at layer 21, then rising to 0.27 at layer 23. The en&el configuration (green line) begins at 0.04, peaks at 0.15 at layer 6, and decreases to 0.05 at layer 21, before rising to 0.30 at layer 23. The en&bn configuration (purple line) starts at 0.04, peaks at 0.15 at layer 6, and decreases to 0.05 at layer 21, then rises to 0.30 at layer 23. All four lines show a general trend of increasing similarity from layer 0 to layer 6, followed by a decrease until layer 21, and a sharp increase from layer 21 to layer 23.
